mission: Explain the refused #197 collector rollout (2026-10-24 06:25Z, 'No redeployable deployment of the verified upload image' in deploy_staging_collectors.capture_before): the collector-redeploy dry run reports, per collector, the active image, the redeployable copy the rollout preflight needs (or why there is none) and the exact-commit copies seen; an apply reports the copy after each redeploy. Read-only additions; apply path unchanged.

impacts.reason: rollback_check(): same test as capture_before (marker commit, active digest, original_source-style scan for a redeployable copy of that digest) plus a short list of exact-commit copies; added to every plan row and the summary (no_rollback_copy); after an apply, rollback_after per redeployed collector. Not part of plan_sha256.
rollback_check finds the redeployable copy of the active image, skips other images and non-redeployable copies, reports the problem otherwise.

routes: Railway GraphQL deployment reads (read-only) in the collector-redeploy dry run
impact.deployment_impact: Tooling only: no service, collector, fleet or schema change.
